Audience
Kon, a terrain scout, needs to find a safe route to the Communications Relay Dome.
Purpose
The report will identify a safe path through Kairova and warn others about routes that are no longer safe.
Meaning
Success means helping people travel safely and keeping communication open between different parts of Kairova.
Discovery
Kon discovered that one of his old routes had been damaged and was no longer safe to use.
Problem
Unexpected changes in the terrain forced Kon to abandon his original plan and find another route.
Response
Kon carefully studied the area, adjusted his plan, and searched for a safer path to the relay dome.
Outcome
Kon successfully found a new safe route and reached the Communications Relay Dome, completing his mission.
